construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch for this isolated build

input.synthetic_fixture: Required boolean indicating synthetic fixture data
input.completed_steps: Unique array of IDs forming a completed prerequisite prefix of the selected plan; array order does not matter

output.plan: Ordered objects containing id, title, completed
output.next_step: Object with id, title, instructions, guidance, estimated_minutes, reason; null when complete
output.message: Personalized next step or completion message

shared_schema.errors: Single JSON object with schema_version=1, status=error, error=description; CLI exits 2
shared_schema.validation: validate_input is shared by the Python API and CLI. Unknown/missing fields, incorrect types, invalid goals, invalid progress, duplicate JSON keys and nonstandard numeric constants are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: validated normalized input feeds deterministic plan selection, progress calculation and personalized next-step output.
behavior: Every goal begins with verify_email and complete_profile.
The final goal-specific task is create_project, invite_teammate or take_tour.
Recommend exactly the first incomplete task; completed onboarding returns no artificial pending task.
Personalize instructions with customer name and guidance with experience.
No live side effects: action instructions are reference navigation paths, not integrations.
Identical inputs produce identical outputs without mutating caller data.
Example and all test customers are clearly labeled synthetic.

included: UTF-8 JSON input and machine-readable errors
Standard-library unittest and subprocess CLI coverage
excluded: Email delivery, actual verification or authentication
Product UI and actual project creation or invitations

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ready, next_step complete_profile
test_outcomes.cli_error_behavior: Passed: invalid input, missing file, directory, malformed JSON and usage errors return status error and exit 2
